per_model.title: Tokens per model (the root page's case 6)
per_model.sql: SELECT model, count(*), sum(tokens) FROM messages GROUP BY model ORDER BY model

daily.title: Messages and tokens per day in March 2026
daily.sql: SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) d, count(*), sum(tokens) FROM messages WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND created_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d

country_plan.title: Tokens by country and plan (join of all three tables)
country_plan.sql: SELECT u.country, u.plan, count(*), sum(m.tokens) FROM messages m JOIN chats c ON c.id = m.chat_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 4 DESC, 1, 2

top_users.title: Top 10 users by tokens in the last 30 days of data
top_users.sql: SELECT c.user_id, sum(m.tokens) t FROM messages m JOIN chats c ON c.id = m.chat_id WHERE m.created_at >= '2026-07-15' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY t DESC, 1 LIMIT 10

monthly_chats.title: Distinct active chats per model per month
monthly_chats.sql: SELECT strftime(created_at, '%Y-%m') mo, model, count(DISTINCT chat_id) FROM messages GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
